chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
C sharp minor with a dark Phrygian flat second
a low hollow pulse-wave lead moving slowly by steps
deep slow bass swells that rise and fall like enormous breathing
sparse high plinks like water dripping in a cavern
distant dry pick-taps and the faint clack of old rails
a dark warm organ pad far in the background
abandoned deep mine galleries in total darkness, ancient and vast
seamless transition back to the theme
